tracks.title: Medley: The Lark In The Morning; Rakish Paddy; Foxhunter's Jig; Toss The Feathers

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1969 (UK).

physical: Pressed by The Gramophone Co. Ltd.
cutters: Porky Prime Cut: George Peckham cut the lacquer
Pecko: George Peckham cut the lacquer

notes.text:
Unlaminated gatefold cover with inner spread that's packed with folklore text & images.

Produced by Joe Boyd for Witchseason Productions Ltd.
Engineered at Sound Techniques Ltd.

Labels :
Pink rim palm tree labels with smooth finish (not rough) and black Witchseason logo.
This release features the copyright: "Ⓟ1969 Island Records Ltd." on the right side of the labels, contrary to other similar versions (see pictures).

Publishing:
• Warlock Music Ltd. - A1 to A4.
• Warlock Music - B1, B2.
• Sparta Music - B3.
• Sparta/Warlock Music - B4.

Runouts are stamped, except for 'PORKY' (etched on side A) and 'PECKO' (etched on side B).
